$comment: SealLink v1.0 OP_RETURN Commitment Framing Registry (SPEC-02). All standard frames fit strictly within Bitcoin/Namecoin MAX_OP_RETURN_RELAY = 83 bytes.
header_format: OP_RETURN(0x6a) PUSH5(0x05) magic(4B='SLNK') action(1B) PUSH_N(1B) payload(N bytes)

locator_types.name: none
locator_types.description: No public locator on chain. Default for private documents delivered inline or via E2EE transport.

locator_types.name: content_sha256
locator_types.description: Content-addressed SHA-256 pointer (e.g., Blossom BUD-01 / HTTP content store).

locator_types.name: nostr_event_id
locator_types.description: Raw 32-byte NIP-01 Nostr event ID (e.g., kind 30079 addressable mirror).

actions.name: GRANT_ISSUANCE
actions.description: Anchors a root or child grant issuance (unilateral or contract-bound).

actions.name: BATCH_ANCHOR
actions.description: Anchors a domain-separated SHA-256 Merkle root (SPEC-02 §5.3: sorted unique 32B digests, tagged leaves/nodes, odd-node promotion without duplication).

actions.name: GRANT_VIOLATION_TERMINATION
actions.description: Optional evidence inside a grant-seal spend referencing a signed moderation/violation verdict.

actions.name: NOTARY_ACT
actions.description: Anchors the signed form of a general notary act (contract notarization, copy, fact, or child attestation).

actions.name: NOTARY_WITHDRAWAL_FOR_CAUSE
actions.description: Authenticated by spending the notary seal or row stop coin; records withdrawal for cause.

actions.name: RESERVED
actions.description: Reserved unused action byte; readers encountering 0x06 MUST refuse with CHAIN_FRAME_INVALID.

actions.name: CONTRACT_ANCHOR
actions.description: Anchors an N-party contract (and optional on-chain assent spend).

actions.name: CONTRACT_TERMINATION
actions.description: Optional signed termination statement inside a contract-seal spend.

actions.name: CREDENTIAL_OR_ORIGIN_ANCHOR
actions.description: Anchors the complete signed form of seallink-origin/1, seallink-credential/1, seallink-capacity/1 (spending status_seal), or seallink-end/1 (terminally spending status_seal).

actions.name: CREDENTIAL_WITHDRAWAL_FOR_CAUSE
actions.description: Authenticated by spending a revocable credential or guardianship seal; binds cause hash.

actions.name: KEY_COMPROMISE_BREAK
actions.description: OwnerPolicy-authenticated compromise height h_c for a credential or notary role key; anchors < h_c survive, >= h_c refuse.

actions.name: NAME_BINDING
actions.description: Committed when spending an origin's single-use binding_seal (or governed dual-party recovery_seal) to bind origin_id to a name registration.

actions.name: GUARDIAN_APPOINTMENT
actions.description: Stage 1 successor appointment (activation_mode=appointed): committed when spending a vacant guardianship slot UTXO (disposer + arbiter 2-of-2 P2WSH) to create the CSV-delayed pending slot output.

actions.name: GUARDIAN_ACTIVATION
actions.description: Stage 2 activation: committed when the appointed guardian spends the CSV-unlocked pending slot output to create the active either_of_2(guardian, disposer) slot seal at vout 0.

actions.name: GUARDIAN_ROSTER_TRANSITION
actions.description: Committed when spending roster_seal (disposer + arbiter 2-of-2 P2WSH) to advance guardianship revision, resize approved revision_size, rotate challenger_pk, or re-anchor a burned slot.

actions.name: RECOVERY_CANCEL
actions.description: Committed inside an owner-authored (SIGHASH_ALL) OP_NAME_UPDATE of the live existing name prior to h_rec + delay_blocks to abort a pending dual-party recovery and restore prior binding admission.

actions.name: SINGLE_USE_CONSUMPTION
actions.description: Committed when the grantee spends a single_use_1_of_2 grant seal via branch 0 (grantee) with SIGHASH_ALL to authorize at-most-once execution of the referenced invocation.

actions.name: GUARDIAN_INITIAL_ACTIVATION
actions.description: Direct initial activation (activation_mode=initial): committed when spending an origin's initial_vacant slot UTXO for the disclosed initial_guardian_commitment (with guardian assent) directly to active_policy at active_vout.
